description: Local simulation bridge between the Godot 4.3 client and the Python domain (ADR 0001; Rich 2026-10-02T18:11Z). Version 2 (2026-10-04, Codex 0907Z request) is additive: structured blockers, labour priority and colony growth blockers; every v1 field is unchanged. Newline-delimited JSON over TCP on 127.0.0.1 (default port 47615). Every request has an integer `id` and an `op`; every reply echoes `id` and `op` and has `ok` (false replies carry `reasons`). The Python domain is the only rules authority: the client renders the `view` and sends player commands. Presentation reads entity state through presentation_states.json values; anything not listed here is unstable. Version 3 adds optional waiting_input.params.consumers; existing fields and protocol unchanged. Version 4 (2026-10-06, Codex 1637Z request, Rich: 'no, all buildings must connect') adds the optional spatial transport mode: hello.spatial, view.spatial, construct position/yaw/footprint, build_road/remove_road commands and the road_disconnected/awaiting_transport blockers. All v4 additions are present only when hello.spatial exists (overlay spatial_roads_v1); protocol and every v3 field are unchanged.
source: economy/bridge.py and economy/engine/spatial.py; verified by tests/test_bridge.py and tests/test_spatial.py

transport.launch: python3 -m economy.bridge --port <port> [--overlay <path> ...] [--governor <path>] (run from the repository root)

spatial.note: footprints = {building: [width, depth]} minimums; default_footprint otherwise. autoplay_available is false in spatial mode.

advance.note: Steps the fixed 1-second simulation; 0 = paused refresh. Pause/speed are client-side.

command.note: Player command with the same legality checks as plans (construct, cancel, demolish, evolve, research, express, set_recipe, pause, resume, set_labour_priority, trade, deliver_contract, decline_contract, begin_great_work, set_policy). v4 spatial mode: construct requires position [x, z] (metres) and accepts yaw (radians) and footprint [width, depth] (never below the domain minimum); build_road {id?, points: [[x, z], ...]} and remove_road {target} are added. Spatial rejection reasons start with 'spatial:' (outside_map, water, too_steep, overlaps_building:<id>, overlaps_road, no_road_network, not_connected, road_not_joined, segment_too_short, road_points_2_to_<n>, malformed_points, malformed_position, position_required, unknown_road:<id>, not_enabled). Spatial construct and build_road accept dry_run: true for an authoritative preview: same checks and reasons, nothing created or paid; a valid road preview's info is 'valid road ' + JSON of the snapped points.

inspect.note: target = facility id, site id, residence id or 'great_work'. `entity` is the inspected id. `blockers` is ordered most actionable first; `reasons` is the same list as plain English text (v1). Facility replies add labour_priority and labour_priority_overridden; residence replies add next_tier, evolution_ready and evolution_workforce_change ({class: delta workers} if the home evolves).

autoplay.note: Reference governor acts alongside the player; a demonstration/balance aid, not game AI. v4: in spatial mode the reply is ok:false with reasons ['spatial:autoplay_unavailable']; no infrastructure is granted.

notes: Entity ids are stable for the life of a session. Facility `status` values and site `state` values are the presentation_states.json enums. A site id becomes the facility id when commissioned (same id).

road_disconnected.note: v4 spatial: the entrance does not reach the anchor's road network; nothing operates or is delivered. Listed first.

waiting_input.note: goods = {resource: missing quantity}; residence form adds purpose='evolution'; consumers maps missing resource to same-district, unpaused running/no_input recipe competitors, excluding the inspected facility. Each row: entity, building, recipe, per_cycle, held, state (running|waiting_input), outputs. Snapshot competition, not historical attribution. Held inputs are not returned by pause. Optional for v2 clients.

environment.note: season or environment factor; detail is diagnostic text

output_blocked.note: RESERVED: never emitted until storage capacity is enforced

awaiting_transport.note: v4 spatial: needs = {resource: quantity} missing locally that carriers are bringing or that wait at the anchor; inbound = goods currently on the way. Goods listed here are not repeated in waiting_input.

blockers.icon_binding: Presentation binds icons to codes (Codex icons: waiting_input, unstaffed, output_blocked, dormant, food_emergency, strained). Unknown codes must fall back to a generic attention icon.

view_spatial.when: view.spatial exists only in spatial mode
view_spatial.coordinates: metres on the client x/z plane (basin_terrain.gd). yaw is radians about +Y as Godot rotates: local (lx, lz) -> (lx*cos+lz*sin, -lx*sin+lz*cos). A building's entrance is on its local +Z face at centre + rotate(0, depth/2 + entrance_offset).

fields.anchor: null until the first road; then {position: [x, z]} = first point of the first road, the founding supply store (view.store)

view_spatial.notes: A placement keeps its id from site to facility/home. A 'pile' is salvage left by a cancelled site or demolished building; carriers collect it and it disappears when empty. local = goods in that building's depot; inbound = goods carriers are delivering to it. Carrier path is the polyline being travelled (anchor->target or back); position is the current point; progress = distance/length. Idle carriers stand at the anchor. A carrier finishes its current leg on the path it started even if a road is removed.
